run_open_terminal_server: run the open-terminal sandbox API server with default host and port settings
run_open_terminal_with_api_key: run the open-terminal server with a custom API key from environment variable
run_open_terminal_with_config: run the open-terminal server using a TOML config file for settings
start_mcp_stdio_server: start the open-terminal MCP server using stdio transport
start_mcp_http_server: start the open-terminal MCP server using streamable-http transport on a custom host and port
